newsitem.title: USA: Canadian spot natgas prices ease after Mon. rally.
newsitem.headline: Canadian spot natgas prices ease after Mon. rally.

text.p: Canadian spot natural gas prices erased some gains Tuesday following Monday's rally on weather and storage withdrawal limits, market sources said.
At the AECO storage hub, prices for Wednesday delivery began at C$3.50 per gigajoule (GJ) but quickly drifted into the C$3.42-3.45 range. On average, prices were down three cents from Monday.
Helping to support the market were forecasts for severely cold temperatures in Alberta through this week.
The strong daily market also pushed term prices higher, traders said.

February AECO prices were talked in the C$2.80-2.90 per GJ range, up from about C$2.60 on Monday. Likewise, March prices climbed about 25-30 cents to the C$2.65-2.75 area. Summer prices edged up about five cents to C$1.75.
At Sumas, Wash., prices for Wednesday delivery lost about 15 cents to about $4.05 per million British thermal units (mmBtu).
At Niagara, spot prices fell about five cents to the $4.00-4.10 per mmBtu range.
